description: This bar chart, titled "Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests," illustrates the average scores achieved by various AI models on these standardized mathematics tests, with scores scaled from 60 to 90 on the vertical axis labeled "Average score (temperature = 0.5)". The horizontal axis lists the model names, ordered from left to right: Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14B Instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4. The chart employs a two-color scheme, with light blue bars representing the "Small model" category and dark blue bars representing the "Small model" category, as indicated by the legend. Each bar is annotated with its corresponding average score, and error bars are shown above each bar, indicating the standard deviation or uncertainty in the measurement. The scores range from 66.4 for Llama-3.3 70B Instruct to 91.8 for phi-4, with the phi-4 model achieving the highest score. The bars are presented in the order listed on the x-axis, and no specific sorting (e.g., descending) is applied. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar beyond the annotation of its value.
